merchant.csv.noteUseExistingId: Use whatever user identifier your system already has (email or username) — it's salted and one-way hashed the moment it's received; we never store the plain text (see the data-handling commitment below). Use the same identifier consistently for the same user
merchant.csv.noteIncrementalOk: Incremental or full uploads both work — the system dedupes by referral code + user, so resubmissions and overlaps never get billed twice
merchant.csv.noteOneCodePerUser: Please ensure on your own system that each user can only use one referral code — if the same user converts through multiple codes, each is billed separately (every ambassador's referral earns its due). Such duplicate costs are the merchant's responsibility
merchant.csv.noteConvertedFlag: Fill "converted" as 1/0; changing 1 back to 0 does not reverse a settlement already paid out
merchant.csv.noteGracePeriod: There's a 30-day grace period after a task closes — data submitted after that won't be accepted, so upload any trailing conversions within the window
merchant.csv.noteCumulative: Enter cumulative totals (as of today) for registrations/usage — not today's new count
merchant.csv.noteNoDoublePay: Only the incremental increase gets settled — resubmitting the same data never pays out twice
merchant.csv.noteNoRefund: Amounts already settled cannot be reclaimed; entering a number lower than the historical value does not trigger a refund
merchant.csv.noteCodeMustMatch: Referral codes must belong to the selected task — uploading against the wrong task will show a clear error
merchant.csv.privacy1: Under our Terms of Service's data-processing clause, the platform never stores plaintext emails or user IDs: they're SHA-256 salted-hashed the instant they arrive, the original is discarded immediately, and nothing is retained in any database or log
merchant.csv.privacy2: The hash is used only for referral-attribution deduplication and settlement reconciliation — never for anything else, and never cross-referenced with other merchants' data
merchant.csv.privacy3: Every display surface (including internal admin tools) shows only the masked form (e.g. a**@gmail.com) — the one-way hash cannot be reversed back to the original
merchant.csv.privacy4: After a task ends, you can contact staff to purge all detail records (settlement receipts are retained separately per accounting requirements)

merchant.agreement.s1: Herix (the “Platform”) is operated by HUAXUE GK, providing recruitment of diaspora-community ambassadors (KOLs), task publishing, and payout settlement services. Brand merchants (“you”) use the Platform to publish tasks and recruit ambassadors to complete promotional or experiential work.
merchant.agreement.s2:
1. You must fund your Platform account before publishing a task; an equal amount is locked as a deposit when the task is published.
2. Once an ambassador completes a task and passes review, the Platform automatically settles payment - this cannot be reversed.
3. The Platform charges a 15% service fee (including payment processing) on each settlement.
4. Unused locked funds may be requested back after a task closes, arriving within 3 business days.
merchant.agreement.s3:
1. Ensure the company information you provide is true and accurate, and update it promptly if it changes.
2. Task content must comply with applicable Japanese laws and Platform rules, and must not contain illegal, false, or misleading content.
3. For approved ambassador applications, review and make a determination promptly after the task ends.
4. You must not bypass the Platform to transact directly with ambassadors.
merchant.agreement.s4: The Platform has final say on the quality of ambassador-submitted content. If you dispute a settlement result, you must raise it with Platform support within 7 days of settlement - after that, it's deemed accepted.
merchant.agreement.h5: 5. Privacy & Data Processing (Data Processing Agreement Clause)
merchant.agreement.s5:
1. The Platform processes your business data per its Privacy Policy. Ambassador personal information is used only for task matching and is never sold to third parties.
2. End-user identifiers (email/user ID, etc.) you upload to verify referral attribution and settlement are data you engage the Platform to process on your behalf: the Platform never stores plaintext (it is SHA-256 salted-hashed and the original discarded the instant it is received, with nothing retained in any database or log), used only for referral-attribution deduplication and settlement reconciliation - never for any other purpose, and never cross-referenced with other merchants' data.
3. All display surfaces (including internal Platform admin tools) retain only masked forms; after a task ends, you may request deletion of all detail records (settlement receipts are retained separately per statutory accounting requirements).
4. You must ensure you have lawful authorization to provide the above data to the Platform (including that your own privacy policy covers this delegated processing); should a data security incident occur, the Platform will notify you within 72 hours of becoming aware of it.
merchant.agreement.s6: The Platform may update this Agreement, with the version number changing accordingly. Material changes will be notified 14 days in advance; continued use of the Platform constitutes acceptance of the updated Agreement.
